title: 608 bearing pillow block
prompt: Model a pillow-block holder for a standard 608 bearing (22 mm OD x 8 mm bore x 7 mm wide): a press-fit bore sized slightly undersize for a light interference fit, a seat at least 8 mm wide (along the bearing axis) to fully support the bearing's 7 mm width, and a flat mounting base with two M5 clearance holes. Drive the bore diameter from a BearingOD parameter (nominal 22 mm, modeled undersized for a press fit) and the mounting-hole diameter from a BoltDia parameter (5.5 mm) via a Parameters spreadsheet.
